title: MAPF-World: Action World Model for Multi-Agent Path Finding
abstract: arXiv:2508.12087v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent path finding (MAPF) studies the problem of planning conflict-free paths for multiple agents from given start locations to designated goals, with applications in robot-assisted logistics and social navigation. Recent decentralized learned solvers have shown promise for large-scale MAPF, particularly when leveraging foundation models and large datasets. However, most existing methods rely on reactive policies, often resulting in congestion, deadlocks, and degraded generalization in high agent-density environments. To address these limitations, we propose MAPF-World, an autoregressive action world model for MAPF that unifies short-horizon local future prediction and action generation, enabling decision-making beyond immediate local observations. translated_title: MAPF-World：面向多智能体路径规划的动作世界模型
translated_abstract: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）研究的是为多个智能体规划从给定起点到指定目标的无冲突路径的问题，在机器人辅助物流和社交导航等领域具有广泛应用。近期的去中心化学习求解器在大规模MAPF问题上展现出潜力，尤其是在利用基础模型和大规模数据集时。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于反应式策略，在高智能体密度环境中常常导致拥堵、死锁以及泛化能力下降。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了MAPF-World，一种用于MAPF的自回归动作世界模型，它将短时程局部未来预测与动作生成统一起来，使决策能够超越即时的局部观测。MAPF-World通过预测下一个局部观测和邻近智能体的动作意图来建模短时程局部动态，同时捕捉空间结构与时间依存关系。
tldr: 该论文提出MAPF-World，一种自回归动作世界模型，通过统一短时程局部未来预测与动作生成，使多智能体路径规划的决策超越即时局部观测，从而在高密度环境中缓解拥堵与死锁并提升泛化能力。
en_tdlr: MAPF-World is an autoregressive action world model for multi-agent path finding that unifies short-horizon local future prediction with action generation, enabling decisions beyond immediate local observations to reduce congestion and deadlocks in high agent-density environments.
